To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a method for finding the MVU estimations for the modified power series distribution, and that this method can be used to find MVU estimators of the parameters for the Lagrangian-Poisson, Lagrangian-Binomial and Borel-Tannner distributions.
The MVU estimators of the parameters of the modified power distributions are obtained and the variance of the estimators is given for some cases.

we have proved the necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of MVU estimators of functions of the parameters for the modified power series distribution and we have obtained the MVU estimations for a number of these functions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
finding the MVU estimations of the functions of some of the parameters of the modified power-series distributions.
the MVU estimations for the MPSD and its special cases, which is of great significance in the study of the MVU estimation for the MPSD.
finding the MVU estimable functions of the parameters of a modified power series distribution and the left truncated modified power series distribution with unknown truncation parameter.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the MVU estimator for a function of a parameter of a MPSD is the MVU estimator of the same function of the same parameter of the corresponding Lagrangian distribution, provided the Lagrangian distribution exists.

the MVU estimator for the function of the parameter of the MPSD is the MVU estimator obtained from the original distribution by replacing each occurrence of the parameter with the function of the para-meter.
this paper is the first one to deal with the MVU estimations of the parameters of the MPSD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a general solution for the MVU estimation for the modified power series distribution (MPSD) which includes the Lagrangian and Borel-Tanners distributions.
we have found the MVU estimator of any function of a parameter of the Lagrangians and the Borels.
we have proved that the MVU estimator of any estimable function of the parameters exists for all the distributions considered.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MVU estimation for a large class of distributions can be carried out using a simple and unified method, and this method is applicable for both truncated and non-truncated cases.
the MVU estimations of functions of the parameters of MPSD are possible.
the minimum variance unbiased estimation for the modified power series distribution is a very useful and powerful tool in many areas of applied statistics.
